title: Atlas DataFlow Training Entrypoint Interface
description: Machine-readable interface for the M24 governed training entrypoint. Project Spec S0244 refactors this schema into a closed discriminated union keyed by schema_version: training-interface.v1 (unchanged in meaning -- tabular classification/regression) and training-interface.v2 (new, strict, univariate-forecasting-only branch). A document must validate against exactly one branch; a document mixing v1 and v2 fields, or declaring an unknown schema_version, validates against neither and is rejected. The entrypoint is contract-driven: it consumes an explicit execution contract path and an explicit prepared dataset path (v2 additionally an explicit preparation recipe path), never notebook-held state, inferred local files, in-memory dataset variables, raw logs, secrets, or implicit outputs from a prior notebook execution. Training run outputs are written under pipeline/training-runs/{dataset_slug}/{run_id}/, where dataset_slug follows ^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$ and run_id follows train-{timestamp}Z, for example train-20260625T120000Z. The prepared dataset path is provided by the caller because the M22 prepared dataset output path is not fixed by this interface.

schema_version.description: Schema version for the governed training entrypoint interface.

entrypoint_kind.description: Identifies this contract as the interface for a governed training command, not the command implementation itself.

required_inputs.description: Required explicit inputs for every training invocation. Both values must be supplied by the caller as reviewable path references; missing values must cause a non-zero exit with a diagnostic message before training begins.

execution_contract_path.description: Required explicit path to the execution_contract.v1 JSON file consumed by the training entrypoint. Missing value behavior: reject invocation with non-zero exit and a diagnostic message naming execution_contract_path.

dataset_path.description: Required explicit path to the prepared dataset file consumed by the training entrypoint. The interface deliberately does not declare a fixed prepared dataset path convention. Missing value behavior: reject invocation with non-zero exit and a diagnostic message naming dataset_path.

permitted_execution_contract_fields.description: Closed list of execution contract fields that the training entrypoint may consume. The fields ignored_columns, required_columns, and optional_columns are deliberately excluded because they are not part of the training-consumption contract for M24.

validation_behavior.description: Validation behavior that every future training implementation must preserve before model training begins.

missing_required_input.description: Missing execution_contract_path or dataset_path is a fatal invocation error. The command must exit non-zero and emit a diagnostic naming the absent input.

dataset_id_mismatch.description: The prepared dataset dataset_id must match execution_contract.dataset_id before training proceeds. A mismatch is a fatal input validation failure.

forbidden_execution_contract_field_consu.description: Training code must not consume execution contract fields outside permitted_execution_contract_fields. In particular, ignored_columns, required_columns, and optional_columns are outside the training interface.

training_run_identity.description: Run identity and output directory convention for M24 training artifacts.

dataset_slug.description: Stable dataset slug used to parameterize training artifact paths. The value must not be hardcoded to a particular dataset.

run_id.description: Training run identifier using the train-{timestamp}Z convention, for example train-20260625T120000Z.

output_directory_template.description: Directory template for all artifacts produced by one training run. The directory may not exist before the run; it is created by the future training implementation, not by this interface schema.

output_artifacts.description: Distinct output artifact roles produced by a governed training run. The training parameter record and metrics artifact are separate roles with separate paths. model_selection_evidence is conditional and omitted when no multi-candidate comparison is performed.

serialized_model.description: Serialized model artifact role. Default path template: pipeline/training-runs/{dataset_slug}/{run_id}/model.pkl. The role name is stable even if a future implementation revises the file extension.

training_parameter_record.description: Training parameter record artifact role. Path template: pipeline/training-runs/{dataset_slug}/{run_id}/training-parameter-record.json. This role records provenance and hashes and must not be merged with metrics.

training_metrics.description: Training metrics artifact role. Path template: pipeline/training-runs/{dataset_slug}/{run_id}/metrics.json. This role is distinct from the training parameter record.

model_selection_evidence.description: Conditional model selection evidence artifact role. Path template: pipeline/training-runs/{dataset_slug}/{run_id}/model-selection-evidence.json. Produced only when multiple model candidates from modeling_constraints.allowed_model_families are evaluated and compared; absence is not a validation failure when not applicable.

model_card_input.description: Model card input data artifact role. Path template: pipeline/training-runs/{dataset_slug}/{run_id}/model-card-input.json. The artifact must be standalone reduced JSON that copies model_family, training_timestamp, primary_metric_name, primary_metric_value, evaluation_split_size, seed, intended_use_context or explicit absence, feature_count, training_data_row_count, and execution_contract_hash. Downstream M24 model-card work consumes this reduced artifact rather than raw training runtime state.

behavioral_constraints.description: Contractual behavior that future training implementation must respect.

contract_drives_split_policy.description: Training split behavior is driven by execution_contract.split_policy.

contract_drives_random_seed.description: Training reproducibility behavior is driven by execution_contract.random_seed.

contract_drives_model_family_candidates.description: Candidate model families are bounded by execution_contract.modeling_constraints.allowed_model_families.

contract_drives_primary_metric.description: Model selection and primary evaluation are driven by execution_contract.primary_metric.

notebook_state_prohibited.description: The training entrypoint must reject invocations that depend on notebook-held state, in-memory dataset variables, or prior notebook execution.

implicit_local_paths_prohibited.description: The training entrypoint must not infer local input paths. Required inputs are explicit path arguments.

hash_policy.description: Hash behavior connecting consumed inputs and produced outputs to the training parameter record.

algorithm.description: All training provenance hashes use SHA-256 hexadecimal digests.

recorded_hashes.description: Hash fields that must be recorded in pipeline/training-parameter-record.schema.json.

interface_boundary_confirmations.description: Boundary flags for M24-01. This schema defines the interface only and does not implement later M24 or M26 work.

training_interface_v2.description: Project Spec S0244: strict, univariate-forecasting-only training entrypoint interface branch. Closed and disjoint from training_interface_v1 -- additionalProperties is false and no v1 tabular field (feature_columns, split_policy, modeling_constraints, etc.) is a member of this branch. Requires an explicit preparation_recipe_path in addition to execution_contract_path and dataset_path, since S0243 deliberately projected only a reduced temporal_evaluation summary into execution_contract.v2 and the full S0242 fold schedule is authenticated only from the preparation recipe.

schema_version.description: Schema version for the univariate-forecasting governed training entrypoint interface.

entrypoint_kind.description: Identifies this contract as the interface for a governed training command, not the command implementation itself.

required_inputs.description: Required explicit inputs for every forecasting training invocation. All three values must be supplied by the caller as reviewable path references; missing values must cause a non-zero exit with a diagnostic message before training begins.

execution_contract_path.description: Required explicit path to the execution_contract.v2 JSON file consumed by the forecasting training entrypoint. Missing value behavior: reject invocation with non-zero exit and a diagnostic message naming execution_contract_path.

preparation_recipe_path.description: Required explicit path to the authenticated candidate-preparation-recipe.v2 JSON file. This is the sole authority for development/holdout boundaries, initial training observations, origin step, fold count, fold schedule, and leakage confirmations -- execution_contract.v2 never duplicates the full fold schedule. Missing value behavior: reject invocation with non-zero exit and a diagnostic message naming preparation_recipe_path.

dataset_path.description: Required explicit path to the prepared univariate time series (.csv or .json) consumed by the forecasting training entrypoint. Missing value behavior: reject invocation with non-zero exit and a diagnostic message naming dataset_path.

permitted_execution_contract_fields.description: Closed list of execution_contract.v2 fields that the forecasting training entrypoint may consume. feature_columns, split_policy, and modeling_constraints are deliberately excluded -- they are v1 tabular-only fields and the forecasting branch must never rely on them.

validation_behavior.description: Validation behavior that the forecasting training implementation must preserve before model fitting begins.

missing_required_input.description: Missing execution_contract_path, preparation_recipe_path, or dataset_path is a fatal invocation error.

preparation_recipe_identity_mismatch.description: Any disagreement between execution_contract.v2 and the authenticated preparation recipe (problem_type, target identity, time-index identity, frequency, forecast_horizon, development/holdout boundaries, fold schedule) is a fatal input validation failure before fitting.

temporal_series_integrity_violation.description: A missing/duplicate/out-of-order time index, a missing/non-numeric/non-finite target value, or a row count disagreeing with the preparation recipe partitions is a fatal input validation failure. The implementation must never silently sort, deduplicate, or fabricate rows to make malformed input pass.

forbidden_execution_contract_field_consu.description: Training code must not consume execution contract fields outside permitted_execution_contract_fields. In particular, feature_columns, split_policy, and modeling_constraints are outside the forecasting training interface.

training_run_identity.description: Run identity and output directory convention for M24 training artifacts, unchanged from training-interface.v1.

dataset_slug.description: Stable dataset slug used to parameterize training artifact paths. The value must not be hardcoded to a particular dataset.

run_id.description: Training run identifier using the train-{timestamp}Z convention, for example train-20260625T120000Z.

output_directory_template.description: Directory template for all artifacts produced by one training run.

output_artifacts.description: Output artifact roles produced by a governed forecasting training run. model_selection_evidence is never a member of this branch -- S0244 forecasting never performs model selection, so no model-selection-evidence artifact role is ever declared or produced. model_card_input is optional and absent unless the existing generic model-card representation can represent forecasting without schema invention.

serialized_model.description: Serialized model artifact role. Path template: pipeline/training-runs/{dataset_slug}/{run_id}/model.pkl. This is the final-development fit, frozen before the sealed final holdout is opened.

model_card_input.description: Optional model card input artifact role. Absent for forecasting unless the existing generic model-card representation can represent forecasting without inventing new schema.

behavioral_constraints.description: Contractual behavior that the forecasting training implementation must respect.

contract_drives_training_policy.description: The frozen model family, fixed model configuration, and finalization policy are driven exclusively by execution_contract.v2.training_policy.

contract_drives_random_seed.description: Downstream reproducibility behavior is driven by execution_contract.random_seed when present.

preparation_recipe_drives_fold_schedule.description: The full expanding-window fold schedule, development/holdout boundaries, and leakage confirmations are driven exclusively by the authenticated preparation recipe, never duplicated into execution_contract.v2.

notebook_state_prohibited.description: The training entrypoint must reject invocations that depend on notebook-held state, in-memory dataset variables, or prior notebook execution.

implicit_local_paths_prohibited.description: The training entrypoint must not infer local input paths. Required inputs are explicit path arguments.

feature_columns_prohibited.description: The forecasting branch never relies on a v1 feature_columns list; it consumes only time_index_column and target_column as source-series columns.

split_policy_prohibited.description: The forecasting branch never relies on v1 random/stratified split_policy semantics; temporal partitioning comes only from the preparation recipe.

modeling_constraints_prohibited.description: The forecasting branch never relies on v1 modeling_constraints; the frozen model specification comes only from execution_contract.v2.training_policy.

external_study_paths_prohibited.description: The forecasting branch must never read, import, or reference an external scientific study project, package, or model artifact at runtime.

model_selection_prohibited.description: The forecasting branch never compares model families, ranks candidates, tunes hyperparameters, or applies practical-tie selection. Exactly one frozen configuration is replayed on every fold and the final fit.

hash_policy.description: Hash behavior connecting consumed inputs and produced outputs to training-parameter-record.v4.

algorithm.description: All training provenance hashes use SHA-256 hexadecimal digests.

recorded_hashes.description: Hash fields that must be recorded in training-parameter-record.v4.

interface_boundary_confirmations.description: Boundary flags for S0244. This schema governs training and evidence only -- it does not authorize inference bundle, runtime, API, candidate, publisher, registry, public metrics, or UI support.

argument_name.description: CLI argument name or equivalent structured invocation key.

explicit_path_argument_v2.description: Project Spec S0244: explicit path argument shape for the forecasting training-interface.v2 branch, adding preparation_recipe_path to the closed vocabulary.

argument_name.description: CLI argument name or equivalent structured invocation key.

path_template.description: Training-run-relative artifact path parameterized by {dataset_slug} and {run_id}.

optional_output_artifact_role.description: Project Spec S0244: an output artifact role that a conforming training implementation may omit entirely.
